title: The GameStop Squeeze Explained Like You're 5
alts: Wall Street Bet a Video Game Shop Would Die. It Backfired.
How a $53,000 Bet Broke a Hedge Fund (GameStop, Explained Like You're 5)
hook: In January 2021, some of Wall Street's biggest players bet that a struggling video game shop would collapse. A man in a red headband had bet about $53,000 that they were wrong. Short selling, the short squeeze, Melvin Capital, the buy button that disappeared, and who actually won, explained like you're five.

chapters.s13: The man in the red headband

sources: US SEC Staff Report on Equity and Options Market Structure Conditions in Early 2021 (October 2021): GME short interest reached 122.97% of float; close $347.51 on Jan 27; intraday high $483.00 on Jan 28
